name: 1392-penaltydecode-llama3-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct -- an ungated re-upload of meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct, same weights and same config. The Meta Llama 3 Community License applies.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. No tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, 8192 trained positions, 16.1 GB of bf16 weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 30%, bounded at 640 requests with an 1800 s safety cap. Do not take the load above 128 in-flight requests on this item: past that the engine at this commit changes regime for reasons unrelated to what is being asked here. Record where the load lands beside the number.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets: prompts 256 +/- 64 tokens (clamped 128-512), generations 512 +/- 64 (clamped 256-768), seed 42. Every request body carries `frequency_penalty: 0.5`, declared in `scenario.json` under `backend.extras.body`.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on a single GPU, serving an 8B model to 16 concurrent users with reduced word repetition.
launch:
# Engine arguments for sglang at commit f3d32f888a25ff62f0d9f5994a1d0420637beb0e.
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented or nested block is dropped by the reader and the engine
# then starts without the mechanism this file declares.

# NousResearch's ungated re-upload of `meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct` (Meta Llama 3
# Community License). Same weights, same config.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct

tp-size: 1

# The model's own trained window: prompt max 512 + output max 768 fits inside it many times over,
# so no request is truncated and no position is extrapolated.
context-length: 8192

mem-fraction-static: 0.85

random-seed: 42
